Three.js 0.186.1, MIT license. These official package build files
were copied from the installed, pinned Three.js dependency used by the local
Brain viewer. No Brain data, configuration or service connection is included.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r186
The ES module imports its adjacent three.core.js. Both are served locally;
there is no CDN or runtime package download.
One indentation-only whitespace normalization was applied in three.core.js.
